ABN AMRO Clearing (AAC) is a leading global player in clearing and clearing related services and strives to optimize profitability, return on invested capital and shareholders value. We have offices around the world, operating in Sydney since 1998; other main offices are located in Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Amsterdam, London, Chicago and Brazil. AAC is ambitious and customer oriented, striving to provide the best integrated service package for the professional business. AAC is a reliable partner, with efficient operations, compliant to all regulations and with a sound risk framework. 

The Software Engineer role contributes to AAC’s mission to optimize performance, risk management, and operational excellence by designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software systems. The position ensures that applications are scalable, reliable, and compliant with financial regulations across APAC. 

The Software Engineer will report to the RAMS APAC Product Owner and be responsible for end-to-end design, development, migration, and optimization of critical clearing applications. This includes: 
• Designing system architecture for applications across Linux, Windows, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and DB2 environments. 
• Leading upgrades and migrations of legacy applications to modern frameworks (Java, Angular, Python, Perl). 
• Ensuring integration, scalability, performance, and maintainability across APAC platforms. 

Key Responsibilities:
1. Software System Design & Architecture 
o Design and implement robust, scalable software architectures for LCM applications. 
o Evaluate and select frameworks, tools, and technologies to optimize system performance. 
o Define database structures and interactions to support enterprise systems. 
2. Development & Engineering 
o Develop, test, and maintain software solutions in Java, Python, Perl, and Angular, aligned with architectural design. 
o Apply engineering best practices (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS) to ensure maintainable and high-quality code. 
3. Application Lifecycle Management 
o Own the full software lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. 
o Lead migration projects, upgrading legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining system integrity. 
4. Technical Leadership & Advisory 
o Provide guidance to Product Owners and the RAMS team on system design, technical decisions, and software strategy. 
o Evaluate software solutions for cost, risk, scalability, and integration into existing APAC systems. 
5. Collaboration & Documentation 
o Work closely with IT teams, Chapter Leads, and APAC CIO to maintain alignment between business needs and software architecture. 
o Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and user manuals. 
6. Risk & Compliance Awareness 
o Ensure all system designs meet regulatory, security, and operational risk requirements. 
o Implement solutions to improve reliability, compliance, and performance of critical clearing systems. 

Required Knowledge and Experience Education: 
• IT-related university degree or equivalent. 
• At least 2+ years in software engineering or system architecture roles. 
• Experience in finance/clearing systems preferred. 

Technical Skills: 
• Software engineering and system architecture experience. 
• Programming: Java (mandatory), Python/Perl, Angular. 
• Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS. 
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MS SQL, DB2, including design and optimization. 
• Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, Unix. 
• Lifecycle management, software engineering methodologies, test management, and IT governance.

## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Position: 	Office Manager 
Salary: 	       $76,000 – $85,000 Plus Superannuation
Location: 	36 Highlander Dr. Craigieburn VIC 3064
Mode: 		Full-Time
Experience:	1 year experience
Royal 3PL Pty Ltd trading as Northedge Cabinets and Cladding, is an Australian-owned company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of premium cabinetry and architectural cladding solutions. The company delivers high-quality products and services to residential, commercial, and multi-unit developments across Australia, working closely with builders, developers, architects, designers, and private clients.
Northedge Cabinets and Cladding provides customised joinery and cabinetry solutions for kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, laundries, offices, and other interior spaces, together with innovative cladding systems that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of modern buildings. The company is committed to delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's design requirements while maintaining exceptional standards of workmanship, quality, and customer service.
The business manages projects from initial consultation and design through to manufacturing, project coordination, delivery, and installation. By integrating skilled craftsmanship with efficient project management and modern manufacturing techniques, Northedge Cabinets and Cladding ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
As the company continues to expand its operations and undertake an increasing number of residential and commercial projects, it has experienced significant growth in its administrative and operational requirements. This growth has created the need for dedicated management of office operations, customer communications, project administration, supplier coordination, procurement activities, and internal business processes.
To support the continued expansion of the business, Royal 3PL Pty Ltd requires a skilled Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative functions, coordinate office operations, streamline internal processes, and provide essential support to management, production, installation teams, suppliers, and clients. The position plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the business while enabling the company to maintain its high standards of service delivery and support its future growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities:

•	Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to ensure efficient workflow and business continuity.
•	Develop, implement and maintain office procedures, administrative systems and record management processes to improve operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate incoming customer enquiries, prepare quotations, maintain job files and ensure project documentation is complete and up to date.
•	Liaise with clients, builders, suppliers and subcontractors regarding project schedules, material deliveries, installation dates and administrative requirements.
•	Prepare and process purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices and related administrative documentation.
•	Monitor office expenditure, maintain financial records and assist management with budget tracking and monthly administrative reports.
•	Coordinate procurement of office supplies and monitor stock of administrative and operational consumables.
•	Maintain accurate records of contracts, supplier agreements, project documentation and company compliance documents.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, timesheets and other human resources administration activities.
•	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Prepare regular administrative and operational reports for management to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement administrative process improvements to enhance productivity and customer service.
•	Provide administrative support to senior management and coordinate communication between office staff, production personnel and installation teams to ensure projects progress efficiently.
	
To be successful in this role, you must have:

•	A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in an office management, administration, or operations coordination role (or as otherwise required under the relevant visa or company policy).
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, document management, and business operations.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to coordinate and support administrative staff.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, suppliers, contractors, and internal teams.

Position Overview
We are looking for a Motion Picture Systems Analyst to support the design, analysis and continuous improvement of technology solutions that enable efficient film, television and digital media production. This role works closely with production, post-production and business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, optimise workflows and implement business systems that enhance collaboration, media management and production performance. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem solver with strong systems analysis experience and the ability to bridge business needs with technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Examine production, post-production and digital content workflows to identify opportunities for improving system performance, operational efficiency and information flow.
Consult with producers, production managers, editors, technical teams and business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document functional and technical requirements.
Evaluate existing production systems and recommend technology enhancements that improve scheduling, resource planning, media asset management and workflow automation.
Develop functional specifications, business requirements, workflow diagrams and process documentation to support software development and system integration activities.
Analyse business processes and operational procedures to ensure technology solutions align with production objectives, compliance requirements and organisational standards.
Coordinate the implementation of new applications, software enhancements and production workflow solutions while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Design, prepare and execute system, integration and user acceptance testing to validate functionality, performance and business requirements before deployment.
Investigate system issues, perform root cause analysis and recommend practical solutions that improve system reliability, usability and operational effectiveness.
Prepare user manuals, technical documentation and training materials, and deliver training sessions that support successful adoption of new technologies.
Collaborate with software developers, infrastructure teams, vendors and third-party providers to integrate production management, digital asset management and enterprise business systems.
Contribute to project planning by assisting with solution design, implementation schedules, resource estimation, risk identification and project documentation.
Provide technical advice and ongoing support to stakeholders, acting as the primary liaison between business users and technical teams throughout system enhancement initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of systems analysis methodologies, business process improvement and software development lifecycles.
Experience gathering business requirements and producing functional specifications, process models and technical documentation.
Knowledge of business process modelling, workflow analysis and system implementation methodologies.
Experience supporting system integration, software deployment and user acceptance testing.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to recommend practical technology solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands and meet project deadlines.
Proficiency with enterprise applications, databases and business systems within technology-driven environments.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within the film, television, broadcasting, streaming or digital media industry.
Knowledge of Media Asset Management (MAM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), production tracking or content management systems.
Experience integrating third-party production platforms, workflow automation tools or cloud-based media solutions.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum or other contemporary project delivery methodologies.
Why Join Us?
Work with innovative technology solutions that support the motion picture and digital media industry.
Join a collaborative team that values innovation, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
Access ongoing professional development and opportunities to work with modern production technologies.
Enjoy a supportive workplace that encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and career progression.
Contribute to projects that directly improve production efficiency and business outcomes.

Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.


We are looking for candidates with the following attributes and experience:

· University graduated, with coursework around software development, computer networks, and web development.

· Two or more years of professional work experience with Workforce and/or Customer Identity related products such as NetIQ, Silverfort, Ping Identity, and Microsoft Entra.

· Experience with developing, implementing, and configuring complex IT Security solutions.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Security concepts and principles (e.g. knowledge of SAML and OAuth).

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash, etc.).

· Networking technologies and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls).

· Virtualisation, Citrix, VMware.

· Cloud computing – AWS, Azure, Google, and hybrid environments.

· Windows Server/Active Directory/ADFS

· Linux (Red hat and/or SUSE), IOS, Android.


We are a focused team with highly experienced staff, a great offering, and you will be part of a growing team with a fun and positive culture. Whatever your goals, there will be plenty of room for career advancement as we grow. Remuneration will be commensurate with skills and experience. If this is the opportunity you have been waiting for, then we want to hear from you! Your resume will be assessed by our team, and if we feel that you could be a good fit, we will be in touch regarding the next steps.

result.description: Cox Purtell Most organisations either have an AI strategist who can't build, or a builder who has no seat at the table. This role offers a rare chance to stay close to the tech, while also having a seat at the table.  A large higher education organisation is bringing in a Head of AI Delivery to own applied AI end to end: shape where it goes, and build the systems that get it there. This is not a hands-off strategy seat, and it is not a pure build seat. It is both, deliberately.   What you'll own:  - Direct input into the organisation's AI roadmap and strategic digital plan - not just executing someone else's - End-to-end delivery of agentic AI, generative AI, LLM and RAG-based systems from concept to production - Establishing the AI capability function from scratch - tooling, delivery patterns, operating model - Mentoring and uplifting existing staff as you build the function around you - Governance, risk, and responsible AI as a core pillar, not an afterthought - transparency, bias mitigation, post-deployment monitoring - Enterprise architecture and cloud platform decisions (Azure, AWS, GCP) - Direct engagement with the CIO, COO, and senior executive leadership   Who you'll report to:  The CIO - technically astute, commercially savvy, and driven to produce outcomes. You'll also be visible to the COO and senior executive leadership. What you build gets seen, and it's expected to demonstrate real value within the first 3-6 months.   What you need:  - You've shipped AI or ML into production before, in a real enterprise - not just a lab or a pilot - You've built or led an AI capability function from the ground up - You've worked hands-on with agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration, not just read about it - RAG, prompt engineering, MLOps/LLMOps - you've actually done this work, not sat in on it - You take governance and responsible AI seriously, in a regulated or genuinely complex environment - You're comfortable being watched by executives and the board, not just your manager   The setup:  - Brisbane-based, hybrid - 2-3 days on-site - Contracted as 12-month fixed-term, but the engagement runs multi-year - real security, not a cliff-edge contract - $180,000-$220,000 plus superannuation - Relocation support available - Standard benefits including leave loading and salary packaging  One non-negotiable: you'll need Australian citizenship or permanent residency for this one.  You'll thrive here if you want both the seat at the table and your hands on the keyboard. You'll struggle here if you only want one or the other - this role won't let you pick.  Want the full brief?
